chapter: Cass Carr, Crawley, Burnet and Cootie Williams
title: Cootie Williams and Alonzo Ross's band join Chick Webb
summary: Webb enlarged to ten pieces by adding Holmes and Cootie Williams, who came from Alonzo Ross's broken-up Florida band that included Cass Carr.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, I was telling you about the time I went with Chick's band, Chick Webb. He had an eight-piece band at the Savoy Ballroom, and he was enlarging the band to ten pieces. And he added myself and Cootie Williams on trumpet to the band, which enlarged it to ten pieces.

Cootie was a trumpet player that came here with Alonzo Ross's band from Florida. And they fell into hard times, and the band broke up -- and they had some pretty good musicians in the band. They had a trumpet player named Melvin Herbert, who was a very good trumpet player, and then Cootie Williams. Then they had a well-known guitar player, Casper Cowie(?) was his name, and he later shortened it to Cass Carr. Cass became a leader himself, and did quite a bit of booking his own orchestra, and had quite a few of the musicians from New York working for him. Then there was a piano...
Tell me more about Cass Carr. He played all kinds of instruments, I think.
Well, he played... He had a banjo or a guitar, and he played bass and musical saw -- bass violin and a musical saw. And he used to take his choruses on the musical saw.
